mapper.sql: i.*, s.name AS store_name, s.code AS store_code, s.platform, d.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, pt.name AS publish_template_name, pr.name AS price_template_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_publish_variant v WHERE v.item_id = i.id) AS variant_count

FROM ecom_publish_item i JOIN ecom_publish_draft d ON d.id = i.draft_id LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = i.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = d.material_id LEFT JOIN ecom_publish_template pt ON pt.id = i.publish_template_id LEFT JOIN ecom_price_template pr ON pr.id = i.price_template_id
